pr.title: feat(app): `basePath` option for the constructor, deprecate `app.basePath()`

summary: This PR adds a `basePath` constructor option to Hono and deprecates the `app.basePath()` method. The changes include a new `HonoOptions` type, refactoring of the constructor signature, and conversion of the `_basePath` field to a private field using `#basePath` syntax. Tests are added for the new option and existing tests are updated. The PR removes the single-argument `route()` overload that was already deprecated, which is a breaking change but appears intentional.

findings.rationale: The single-argument `route()` overload (e.g., `app.route('/api')`) has been removed. While this was deprecated with a comment stating removal in v4, the PR description does not explicitly mention this breaking change. Code using `app.route('/api')` without a second argument will now fail to compile.
findings.suggestedCheck: Verify that the removal of single-argument `route()` is intentional and document it in the PR description. Check if there are any internal or external usages of this pattern that need migration.
